1.consolidated_definition: Árbol duro y pesado, de hasta 25 m de altura, de hojas brillantes, oscuras y lisas, flores blancas, grandes y aromáticas; su madera es muy usada en ebanistería. (Magnoliaceae, Magnolia portoricensis).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree with a hard and heavy trunk, reaching up to 25 m in height, featuring bright, dark, and smooth leaves, large white flowers with a strong fragrance; its wood is highly valued for carpentry purposes (Magnoliaceae, Magnolia portoricensis).
